ARIES Project Associate II Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for ARIES Project Associate II Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for ARIES Project Associate-II Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Project Associate-II position at ARIES is scheduled for 23rd September 2026. Candidates should ensure they report to the venue on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Associate-II post?
faq.answer: The required qualification is a Bachelor's Degree in Engineering or Technology in Electronics and Communication Engineering (ECE) or an equivalent degree from a recognized University.

faq.question: Q3. What is the maximum age limit for the Project Associate-II position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Project Associate-II post is 50 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Associate-II role?
faq.answer: The salary offered is Rs. 42,000 + HRA per month for candidates with valid GATE/CSIR-UGC NET qualification, and Rs. 33,000 + HRA per month for those without.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the ARIES Project Associate-II recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for this recruitment will be based on a Walk-in Interview. Candidates need to attend the interview directly.

faq.question: Q7. Where is the walk-in interview scheduled to be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at Aryabhatta Research Institute of Observational Sciences (ARIES), Nainital, Uttarakhand, Pin code: 263001.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry all original documents, including ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if any), and category certificates, along with one set of self-attested photocopies.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: This is a contractual job opportunity at ARIES. The tenure and terms of employment will be as per the institute's policy for contractual positions.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and more details?
faq.answer: The official notification and further details can be found on the ARIES official website. Links for the notification and website are provided in the 'Important Links' section of this article.
